[EN] It isn't enough to take an objective, one must be able to hold it as well. Thulsa's forces are dug into their fortress, but that doesn't mean they can't be dislodged. The question for us is if it's worth the cost in blood.
[ES] No basta con tomar un objetivo, también hay que saber mantenerlo. Las fuerzas de Thulsa están atrincheradas en su fortaleza, pero eso no significa que no puedan ser desalojadas. La pregunta para nosotros es si vale la pena el costo en sangre.
